items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And we had Hilton Jefferson on first... I played baritone in this band

ctx.x: Right, so we're back with Cab.

And I went with Cab. I played baritone in this band, baritone sax. And we had Hilton Jefferson on first and the fellow that used to be with the Blue Rhythm Band. I can never think of his name, on alto with Cab. He used to be with the Blue Rhythm Band, and he's from Chicago. He's been working out -- he just retired from the U.N. here late -- here recently. I can never think of that boy's name, and I knew him for years. Well, anyhow, it was Jeff, him and I was playing

baritone, had Ike Quebec on one tenor and Sam Taylor on the other tenor. Jonah Jones and Doc Cheatham and Shad Collins were the trumpets. And Butch -- I don't know his last name -- he was on one trombone, and Eddie Burke was on the other trombone.
